title: RSA stub mode silently accepts wrong key size in per-algo import wrappers
description: Trigger: build without CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT (stub mode), then call wolfssl_rsa_2048_key_import() with a 4096-bit key (or vice versa). The expected_key_bytes validation is inside #ifdef CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT so it never runs in stub mode. wolfssl_rsa_2048_key_import() accepts a 4096-bit key silently instead of returning -EINVAL. Violates the documented invariant that rsa-2048 handles must not accept rsa-4096 keys. Stub mode is not production, but the invariant should hold. Fix: add a stub-mode size check using rawlen heuristic or just enforce expected_key_bytes unconditionally before the ifdef block. src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_rsa.c:195-281
close_reason: Stub now propagates expected_key_bytes to key_size_bytes so rsa-2048/rsa-4096 stubs are self-consistent; documented that full invariant enforcement requires wolfCrypt (cannot parse DER in stub mode)
